entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create an original production concept board for the existing medieval low-fantasy pixel art mod, a TWO-STATE comparison of exactly the same street-facing notice typesetting station. Landscape 1536x1024, two equal panels separated by a thin neutral gutter, identical elevated 3/4 camera and scale. Reference image 1 is style and station reference: use ONLY its LEFT typesetting room, not its separate account room. Pixel-art clusters, sharp stepped silhouettes, restrained brown timber, gray stone, cream paper, charcoal metal, olive accents, diffuse daylight, no painterly blur. Frame close enough that the wooden type tray and missing row are plainly readable. In BOTH panels identical timber table, SAME tilted wooden type tray, small loose-type box, fixed stone wall and open street foreground. One original cream old proof sheet lies FLAT in a dedicated small wooden holder at the far left of the table in both panels; preserve the same original ink pattern and position without overwriting it. Its marks are abstract lines, not legible words or personal data. LEFT unresolved state: tray has rows of dark type with one very obvious EMPTY horizontal slot across the middle, exposed brown wood and no type in that row; a compact bottom advertisement block occupies three rows. RIGHT conditional corrected public-notice prototype: fill that EXACT empty middle slot with finite dark type blocks, shrink the bottom advertisement block to one row, and add ONE new corrected cream printed sheet to the RIGHT of the tray with the matching additional abstract line and smaller ad rectangle. Keep the old proof in its left holder intact. All other surroundings unchanged. No account table, coins, payment marks, banners, crowds or people. No caption, arrows, labels or legible lettering. This represents a conditional physical asset only: publicnotice requires verified affected streets, explicit printer/publication permission, actual finite print costs and ad-refund resources, actual printing and posting, and confirmation; this board itself proves none of those and never applies to the doorway alternative. No citywide-notified claim, no erased history, no game state changes. Emphasize the visually clear empty-row versus filled-row difference and the intact old proof in both states.

qa.visual_result: 缺行→同处填入字块清楚，新成页增加，旧试印在原位保留；无账台/已付标志。
limitations: 广告区域缩小不能从抽象版面独立认证；需将来手工已核排版。
桌上成页不证明实际印贴或街段送达，publicnotice全部条件独立核；绝不用于doorway。
墨块不可读，不能证明街名、实测范围或个人同意。
相机与场所接近固定但非像素注册；原生网格、色数、切片、碰撞尚未验收。

entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Produce a TWO-STATE original pixel-art environment prototype board for a medieval coastal net shelter, landscape 1536x1024, exactly two equal panels, identical elevated three-quarter camera, same shelter and scale. Input image 1 supplies ONLY rope/net material, old fraying and historical clean-cut damage vocabulary; do not repeat its closeup composition. Input image 2 supplies ONLY panel C's weathered wind-facing timber and thatched shelter atmosphere; do not reproduce all six scenes, people, smokehouse or quantities. Muted umber timber, oat hemp rope, warm gray stone, dusty olive weeds. Sharp pixel clusters and stepped silhouettes, limited shading, no blur. Both panels show the SAME small thatched open shelter, SAME low wooden horizontal drying rack, SAME pebbled dry footpath continuously running in FRONT and around one side back to the street. Clear ground and safe headroom, no net over the path. No humans, children, blades, tools held by people, water danger, rescue reenactment, smoke/fire, fish, boats or extra buildings. LEFT unresolved state: ONE continuous modest rectangular shared net is hanging over the rack. One small worn/frayed patch near its left quarter and one existing cut-gap in its right quarter clearly distinguishable, already historical and static. RIGHT conditional divided-net state: the original one-piece net no longer exists as a continuous silhouette. Its SAME finite material is now divided into THREE modest independent smaller net sections hanging separated by very obvious empty gaps on that SAME rack, each with finished bound edges, their total visible mesh area no greater than the left panel's original. Three is an ART LAYOUT proposal only, not canonical inventory. Preserve identifiable old worn fibers on the leftmost piece and the old repaired-but-visible cut scar on the rightmost piece, never pristine replacement nets or erased evidence. No remaining large net hidden behind, no bonus coils of material, no additional nets anywhere. Shelter, rack, dry access and ground stones must stay fixed. No labels, title, words, arrows, numbers or UI. This asset only imagines CS-DEN-02 branch b after lawful ownership-share verification, net-owner authorization, the newcomer's voluntary independent choice, genuine compensation and missed-work accounting, real usable finite small nets and actual handover plus confirmation. It does not assert those conditions or any game state are fulfilled, does not imply eviction, compelled cohabitation, restored large-net efficiency, or universal reconciliation. Visually prioritize ONE continuous outline versus THREE truly disconnected smaller outlines with less or equal total mesh, historical damage retained and the exact safe dry route.

Keep all other pixels, left panel including historical open hole, shelter, rack, foreground dry path, three separate net silhouettes, gaps, dimensions, colors and sharp pixel style unchanged. Carefully mend that one old hole with a modest visibly irregular darker hemp PATCH OF KNOTTED MESH, attached to the existing ragged rim, with a clear repaired scar around its boundary. The patch's darker knots and preserved original frayed rim must make the historical damage still readable; it must NOT become a pristine new net and must NOT remain an unusable open hole. Use minimal repair thread, no expanded net silhouette or extra net. Also bind the existing loose lower ends of the leftmost small net discreetly while retaining its old frayed scar. Do not change anything in the left panel, do not connect the three nets, no extra materials or nets, no people, blades, children, labels, arrows or words. The right panel is only a conditional prototype of lawfully divided, compensated and actually handed-over limited usable nets; it does not assert gameplay completion or erase historical evidence.
